messages:
Rina M.: quick thought: the inline role pills are great but users keep asking where the "Invite" vs "Set role" action lives. proposing explicit microcopy on the pill: 'Set role (no email)' and an action link 'Invite & add' in the expanded overlay. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/new/inline-pills :sparkles:

Dale H.: +1. also log concern: when people change roles via the pill we should include method="pill-inline" in audit rows so support can filter these events.

Priya S.: accessibility note: the overlay must be a dialog for screen readers, trap focus, and include clear aria-labels like 'Set role to Power for Alex (no email)'. Color contrast for the selected pill must meet 4.5:1.

Aran K.: keyboard behavior: arrow keys move between pills, Enter selects, Esc closes. Locked SSO roles should be aria-disabled and show a small tooltip 'SSO enforced by org policy' on hover/focus.

AccessBot: sample audit entry: {event: "role.change", actor: "rina.m@redwood.com", target: "alex@org.com", from: "Guest", to: "Power", method: "pill-inline", ts: "2025-06-10T14:22:00Z"}

Rina M.: Implementation checklist for engineering: 1) overlay dialog semantics + keyboard map, 2) aria-disabled for SSO locks + tooltip copy, 3) emit structured audit event with method pill-inline, 4) microcopy: 'Set role (no email)' and 'Invite & add', 5) undo toast: 'Changed Alex to Power — Undo' (aria-live=polite). Tagging: @Aran K. for keymap, @Priya S. for a11y pass.

Priya S.: I'll run VoiceOver + NVDA once the prototype is uploaded.

Dale H.: I'll wire audit event and toast with 10s undo window.

Rina M.: thanks team — we'll review this Fri in the design sync. :rocket:
